int then clamp to 1..(5 + inventory.heart_container); a save does not restore a dead player with 0 HP.

Copied directly; unlike NG metadata, load_game has no invalid-weapon fallback.

Known slot, string item belonging to exactly that slot, finite numeric owned count>=1. Otherwise omit entry. normalize_owned retains only registered gear IDs at quantity 1. Empty selection is intentional and must remain empty; ownership alone provides no gear bonus.

Hair must belong to gender's catalog, else third style by catalog order; eyes must be known, else rond. Color indexes int-cast and clamped to catalog bounds. Catalog order is part of index semantics.

Known slot, Dictionary entry, correct known item for slot and finite numeric owned quantity>=1. Keep {item,dye}; dye int-cast and clamped to palette bounds. Cosmetic clothing remains distinct from equipment/bonuses.
skill -> finite numeric integer 0..1350 for registered skills
exact resource_id -> absolute active play_time deadline
optional nonempty registered recipe_id string; invalid or empty values omitted by normalization

Discard expired deadlines <= loaded play_time; clamp each valid deadline to play_time+that resource's own cooldown. Preserve raw data that normalization drops.
absolute active play_time deadline for wild grapes

values.value: Valid farm cells are Rect2i(4,29,31,12), excluding columns 20 and 21; only soil/channel entries remain.
Known soil crops retain growth 0..duration and exact-true fertilized. established exact true is retained only if that crop has a regrow duration.
Registered crop IDs: grape,flower,carrot,pumpkin,mint,rosemary,apple,berry; crop duration/yield are defined by orchard_catalog.gd.
Jobs: compost cost 2 manure, yield 3 fertilizer, 30s; wine_a and wine_b cost 3 grapes, yield 1 wine, 90s. Each job batches finite numeric clamp/truncate 1..20 and elapsed time 0..job duration.
animal_due and drops: at most 128 entries each; IDs must be strings <=140 characters. animal_due clamp 0..loaded play_time+90. Runtime creates at most 64 drops.
Drop map must be string and pos a two-number array; coordinates finite-normalized to 0..10000. Normalizer does not whitelist the map string.
wild_due clamp 0..loaded play_time+120; honey integer 0..8; honey_time 0..120. Invalid/nonfinite numeric input falls to the lower bound.

entries.value: Dictionary with known material-type items only; max 12 distinct slots in source iteration order; each finite numeric count>=1 truncates/clamps to 1..99.

home accepts known material/use/ammo items, max 144 distinct slots in source iteration order, finite numeric count>=1 clamps/truncates to 1..999. No equipment is stored here. favorites retains known IDs with value==true. sort finite numeric truncates/clamps 0..3; else 0.

Defaults also contain zero-owned entries for all other catalog kinds. Known owned counts cannot fall below starter ownership and clamp at kind cap. Accept layout only if whole layout_reason succeeds; otherwise retain default layout while preserving normalized ownership/style. Max12 pieces, max26 solid cells; bed/table/shelf mandatory; grid room [2,12)x[2,12), fixed fixtures/reserved paths/no overlaps and full connected walkable floor. Non-base furniture ID kind:1..cap; base ID exactly kind. Integer tint 0..2.
array of unique known extension IDs

Known extensions west/east; known supply counts finite, clamped by per-group cap and starter minimum. Stations [] preserved; two finite coordinates in [0,40)x[0,44) truncate to integers. If initial station layout invalid, changed stations are stored rather than destroying crops/jobs. Add optional pieces individually with exact canonical cell keys and correct path/fence kind; max80 paths/max40 fences. Validate land ownership, terrain, reserved/fixed cells, existing farm/tree cover, station spacing, material ownership and connectivity. If final whole layout invalid, clear paths/fences only. Farm is normalized first and is not overwritten.

Nonempty ui_owners pauses the tree; menus/dialogue/pause therefore stop both active clocks. transitioning alone does not pause clocks.
Seconds increased by frame delta under active predicate; saved as numeric, not a wall-clock timestamp.
day_time += delta/480; crossing1 wraps with fposmod and increments day_count. Both components are saved.
skip_to_morning sets day_time=.08 and increments day_count only if previous day_time>.08. Does not advance play_time or production/resource deadlines.
Resource, wild-grape and animal timers are absolute deadlines on play_time. Harvest/production growth is stored elapsed active seconds; no real-time/offline catch-up.

Advances while active on every map. Crops grow only when irrigation/water checks pass; batches mature to recipe duration, collected later; honey needs >=3 flowers, 120s/unit up to8, then timer resets. A stored hive pauses production without losing honey.

fposmod(day_time*480,96): low[0,48), rising[48,60), high[60,84), falling[84,96). No independent tide save. High/falling bank becomes water; transition waits if the player occupies bank. On load safe arrival is reconstructed.
Deterministic from map climate plus day_count/day_time slot; six80-second random-weather slots/day. No independent RNG/weather state field. Preserve integer hash behavior when ported.
Full rows/colliders/NPC positions are not serialized. Assemble catalog maps in exact enrichment order, then rebuild runtime geometry/entities from persistent flags, clocks and home state.
